note: Pitcairn Islanders are British citizens and travel on British passports, as New Zealand's immigration manual records; the United Kingdom issues no national identity card (Identity Documents Act 2010), so they hold none.

sources.title: Immigration New Zealand, Operational Manual, V3.60 Pitcairn Islanders (effective 29 November 2010)
sources.said: Note: Pitcairn Islanders are British citizens and travel on British passports. ... Pitcairn Islanders who arrive in New Zealand without a passport may be: given a certificate of identity; and granted an initial 6-week visitor visa; and also advised to obtain a British passport.

sources.title: GOV.UK, Pitcairn Island
sources.said: Passports and emergency travel documents in Pitcairn Island Includes how to cancel a lost passport, renew a passport and apply for an emergency travel document. ... Overseas British passport applications

sources.title: legislation.gov.uk, Identity Documents Act 2010, section 1, Repeal of Identity Cards Act 2006
sources.said: Repeal of Identity Cards Act 2006 ... The Identity Cards Act 2006 is repealed.

sources.title: legislation.gov.uk, Identity Documents Act 2010, section 2, Cancellation of ID cards etc
sources.said: No ID cards are to be issued by the Secretary of State at any time on or after the day on which this Act is passed. ... All ID cards that are valid immediately before that day are to be treated as cancelled by the Secretary of State at the end of the period of one month beginning with that day.
